name: Mobile Suit Gundam Wing
description: After Colony (A.C.) 195. Mankind has moved into space. Thousands of people live on giant orbiting space colonies called "Sides." However, the Earth Government, which rules the colonies, is unjust and cruel. A group of revolutionaries builds five robotic weapons called Gundams and plans to send them to Earth to begin their fight for independence. Piloted by five young men, these Gundams carry the hopes and dreams of freedom of the colonists with them as they descend to Earth to begin Operation Meteor!

videos.title: Operation Meteor I: Odd Numbers
videos.overview: Feature-length episode recapping events from the Gundam Wing TV series from the point of view of  Heero, Trowa and Wufei. The episode also features brief amounts of new footage of the characters after the events of the TV series.

videos.title: Operation Meteor I: Even Numbers
videos.overview: Feature-length episode recapping events from the Gundam Wing TV series from the point of view of Duo and Quatre. The episode also features brief amounts of new footage of the characters after the events of the TV series.

videos.title: Operation Meteor II: Odd Numbers II
videos.overview: Feature-length episode recapping events from the Gundam Wing TV series from the point of view of  Heero, Trowa and Wufei. The episode also features brief amounts of new footage of the characters after the events of the TV series.

videos.title: Operation Meteor II: Even Numbers II
videos.overview: Feature-length episode recapping events from the Gundam Wing TV series.from the point of view of Duo and Quatre. The episode also features brief amounts of new footage of the characters after the events of the TV series.

videos.title: Endless Waltz: Silent Orbit
videos.overview: Relena, now a deputy Foreign Minister for the ESUN, is abducted while on her way to colony X-18999. To her astonishment, the one responsible for her abduction is Mariemaia Khushrenada, Treize's daughter and the granddaughter of Dekim Barton, leader of the Barton foundation. However, it soon becomes clear that Mariemaia is being manipulated by her grandfather to complete his second scheme of total domination of that Earth sphere. Heero and Duo, having learned of Relena's abduction, decide to investigate and send Quatre on a dangerous mission to recuperate the Gundams, while Trowa learns about Dekim's latest bid for power and decides to stop him. However, as he tries to kill Dekim, Trowa is stopped by Wufei, now a member of Mariemaia's forces!

videos.title: Endless Waltz: Operation Meteor
videos.overview: As they arrive at X-18999, Heero and Duo are met by Wufei and Trowa, who fire at them. It soon becomes evident that they were faking things only to make it easier for his friends to infiltrate the colony. Meanwhile, Mariemaia declares war on the ESUN and departs for Earth with Relena. At the same time, a lone MS, piloted by Zechs Merquise, now a ESUN agent, approaches the asteroid MO-III, where Mariemaia's forces prepare themselves for their impending assault on Earth and threatens to blow it to pieces. Dekim's only answer is that if Zechs so much as sneezes, he will drop the asteroid on Earth.

videos.title: Endless Waltz: Return to Eternity
videos.overview: Mariemaia's forces descend on Brussels, the ESUN's capital, where Mariemaia, her grandfather and Relena go into a huge, super-armored bunker. Meawhile, Zechs and Lucrezia Noin try, without success, to stop Mariemaia's MS troops, until the Gundam Heavyarms, Sandrock and Deathscythe H arrives, that is, with the only two missing Gundams duking it out during atmospheric re-entry.

videos.title: Frozen Teardrop Picture Drama - A New Battle
videos.overview: Special included in the second of two remastered Gundam Wing Blu-ray boxes based on the novel series Gundam Wing Frozen Teardrop.

videos.title: The Shooting Star She Saw
videos.overview: In an effort to end many years of tyrannical rule, five pilots and their Gundams are dispatched to Earth to begin Operation Meteor. Four land without incident, but one is intercepted and his mission is compromised.

videos.title: The Gundam Deathscythe
videos.overview: Heero plans to destroy the Wing Gundam before it is discovered by the Alliance forces. Heero gets his hands on two torpedoes and attempts to destroy his Gundam. Relena, refusing to believe Heero's threat, tries to confront him but is interrupted by the arrival of Duo Maxwell...

videos.title: Five Gundams Confirmed
videos.overview: Heero is injured and is kept for treatment at the Alliance hospital. At the Corsican base of the Mediterranean, the Gundam Heavyarms, piloted by L3's Trowa Barton, annihilates everything in its path. Then things get even worse for the Alliance when the Gundam Sandrock shows up.

videos.title: The Victoria Nightmare
videos.overview: L5's Wufei Chang, in his Shenlong Gundam, attacks the Taurus MS's transports after coming into Lake Victoria base late at night. Lucrezia Noin, head instructor at the base and good friend of Zechs Merquise, tries to fight him off in her Aries MS.

videos.title: Relena's Secret
videos.overview: Relena and her father, Vice Foreign Minister Darlian, journey to the colonies to try and prevent war. but there are those who do not want peace. Amidst the grief and tragedy, Relena learns her true identity...

videos.title: Party Night
videos.overview: Relena goes back to Earth. Wufei attacks another Alliance base and Trowa has started to work in a circus as a cover. Back at school, Relena tells Heero that she knows everything about him and invites him to a party, to be held that night.

videos.title: Scenario for Bloodshed
videos.overview: Treize Kushrenada's plans to destroy the Alliance come to a head when the leaders of the Alliance hold a meeting. The meeting is led by Marshal Noventa and outlines his peace agenda. However, based on Treize's false intelligence, the Gundams destroy the Alliance leadership, and Oz begins to take over Earth.

videos.title: The Treize Assassination
videos.overview: Lady Une makes the Gundams her next target and activates the self-destruct sequence on the New Edwards Base. Can Heero prevent the explosion of the New Edwards Base and find the person who set them up? Meanwhile, Wufei duels with Treize.

videos.title: Portrait of a Ruined Country
videos.overview: The United Earth Sphere Alliance collapses, sending the entire Planet into a panic. This allows OZ to step forward and take control through a well planned coup. Zechs is occupied with other things: he is searching for the ruins of the Sanc Kingdom.

videos.title: Heero, Distracted by Defeat
videos.overview: Lady Une briefs her troops on another strategy to try and wipe out the Gundams. Heero and Zechs face each other again, but this time it's the Wing Gundam versus the Tallgeese.

videos.title: The Whereabouts of Happiness
videos.overview: The Gundams have been defeated. With the colonies used as shields, the pilots don't have a chance. No one knows whether Heero is dead or alive. On the trail of her father's killer, Relena heads to Moscow. Duo and Quatre take refuge with the Maguanac Corps.

videos.title: Bewildered Warriors
videos.overview: The Gundams must fight to regain peace. Wufei meets Sally Po on the battlefield and tells her that the weak should not be fighting. Still, lost in his emotion, Wufei once again gets into his Shenlong Gundam.

videos.title: Catherine's Tears
videos.overview: Two misguided OZ soldiers are going on an execution spree, destroying any remaining Alliance resistance. In an effort to save the colonies, Trowa heads for his final battle. However, Catherine stands between him and his death wish...

videos.title: The Order to Destroy 01
videos.overview: To try and make up for his mistake of killing the honorable pacifist leader Noventa, Heero confronts his granddaughter, Sylvia Noventa. Meanwhile, Zechs is handed an order from the Romefeller Foundation...

videos.title: To the Battleground, Antarctica
videos.overview: Zechs' warrior nature craves a decisive battle. Noin invites Heero to Antarctica, where Zechs awaits. Suspecting that Zechs has violated the order to destroy Zero One, the Romefeller Foundation sends troops after him.

videos.title: The Sorrowful Battle
videos.overview: At the South Pole, Zechs waits with the newly-rebuilt Wing Gundam. After Herro arrives and the rematch begins, Relena arrives and tries to stop them from wasting their lives. However, she discovers a revelation...

videos.title: Betrayed by Home, Far Away
videos.overview: OZ sets in motion its plans to destroy the Alliance military once and for all. Quatre and Duo head to outer space to warn the colonies of the impending danger, only to discover they've been declared the enemy.

videos.title: Tallgeese Destroyed
videos.overview: The fight between the Tallgeese and the Gundams conclude. Now, Zechs refuses to fight for, and ends his affiliation with the Romefeller Foundation.

videos.title: Assault on Barge
videos.overview: The Gundam Deathscythe single-handedly battles OZ's Mobile Suits in space, and Duo ends up getting captured. Heero searches for Duo in order to silence him...

videos.title: The Lunar Base Infiltration
videos.overview: OZ is developing 2 new Mobile Suits that can challenge the Gundams. Heero accepts the mission to sneak in and sabotage their operations. But he is unprepared for who he meets while inside the base...

videos.title: Grief-Stricken Quatre
videos.overview: A wild Mobile Suit approaches the colonies at high speed; Lady Une orders test pilots Heero and Trowa to stop it. Meanwhile, Quatre, exhausted from the pressure of his missions, returns home for a visit. But what he finds there is not comfort, only more chaos and tragedy.

videos.title: The Fight for Independence
videos.overview: The colonies have begun arming themselves for the coming fight against OZ. However, more surprising than that is the switch in Lady Une-she's become an advocate for peace. She is now acting on Treize's behalf without the consent of the Romefeller Foundation.

videos.title: Duo, the Great Destroyer Once Again
videos.overview: With Lady Une's help, Duo escapes from OZ and goes to destroy the Mobile Suit production base on the moon. But while there, he meets a girl named Hilde who has become a soldier. The choice is suddenly much more complicated.

videos.title: The Gundam They Called Zero
videos.overview: A Mobile Suit with fantastic power is on a rampage. It's attacking the colonies one after another in a brutal display of raw power. Trowa and Heero move to intercept this strange new Mobile Suit and are surprised by who its pilot is...

videos.title: Quatre VS Heero
videos.overview: Trowa and Heero must battle their crazed friend; but they find themselves losing against this new Gundam. Treize, meanwhile, disapproves of the Romefeller Foundation's plan to use Mobile Dolls-automated Mobile Suits without pilots. His dissension results in his arrest by OZ.

videos.title: The Eternal Flame of the Shooting Stars
videos.overview: Treize is freed by OZ soldiers loyal to him, but the trouble is only beginning. Romefeller is out to eliminate the Gundams and Treize, since they are symbols of hipe. Operation NOVA commences, and all of the Earth is in danger.

videos.title: The Locus of Victory and Defeat
videos.overview: Relena, thinking back on past events, becomes determined to put an end to the Romefeller Foundation's tyranny.

videos.title: Passing Destinies
videos.overview: Treize, while not in the middle of the battlefield, continues to scheme.

videos.title: The Heroine of the Battlefield
videos.overview: Romefeller is gaining ground on Earth very quickly and Treize and his troops seem to be losing the battle. When Heero realizes that Treize is now fighting Romefeller, he joins his army as a mercenary and finds himself working alongside Sally Po and Lucrezia Noin.

videos.title: The Reunion with Relena
videos.overview: Quatre isn't convinced that Heero's mercenary path is the correct one. However, having witnessed the horrors of war, he cannot stand by and do nothing. When Relena declares the Sanc Kingdom's neutrality, Quatre and Heero take refuge.

videos.title: The Glass Kingdom
videos.overview: Heero and Quatre decide to stay in the Sanc Kingdom and help Relena promote pacifism. But when the Romefeller Foundation attacks, Heero, Quatre and Noin go into battle.

videos.title: The Great Destroyer Meets Zero
videos.overview: Still in space, Duo has been retaliating against OZ. But OZ closes in, and Duo and his incomplete Gundam Deathscythe Hell must fight the Wing Zero.

videos.title: The Lonely Battlefield
videos.overview: Zechs steps onto the battlefield once again and attacks Romefeller's forces. Meanwhile, Heero heads off to help the Treize Faction.

videos.title: And Its Name Is Epyon
videos.overview: Zechs gets the Wing Gundam Zero and demolishes the OZ forces. However, Treize gives Heero a new Gundam, perhaps the most terrible Gundam of all, and its name is Epyon...

videos.title: The Return of Wufei
videos.overview: Wanting to join the Gundam pilots in their fight, Zechs goes to meet Wufei, But Wufei, pilot of the new Altron Gundam, believes him to be the enemy.

videos.title: Sanc Kingdom's Collapse
videos.overview: Duo and Trowa are reunited and team up against the enemy once more. Meanwhile, the Romefeller Foundation has mounted a final assault against the Sanc Kingdom, forcing Relena to surrender to prevent a battle.

videos.title: Zero VS Epyon
videos.overview: Relena, now a prisoner of the Romefeller Foundation, is faced with a very difficult choice. Meanwhile Heero and Zechs engage in battle once again-this time on the grounds of the Sanc Kingdom.

videos.title: The Birth of Queen Relena
videos.overview: A group of rebel colony citizens calling themselves the "White Fang" starts attacking OZ bases. Quatre and Noin search for the other Gundam pilots. The Romefeller Foundation names Queen Relena as their representative.

videos.title: Trowa's Return to the Battlefield
videos.overview: Quinze, the leader of the White Fang, contacts Zechs and asks him-and his Gundam-to join their cause. Still suffering from amnesia, Trowa once agian goes into battle.

videos.title: A New Leader
videos.overview: As Relena takes her first step towards trying to achieve true peace, Heero sets out to eliminate her. Milliardo Peacecraft, the new leader of the White Fang, is now intent on going to war against OZ, the Romefeller Foundation and the Gundam pilots.

videos.title: Crossfire at Barge
videos.overview: With Milliardo Peacecraft's declaration of war against the Earth in effect, the battle rages on between the White Fang and OZ. Meanwhile, Treize returns to take control of the Romefeller Foundation, forcing Relena to step down. In space, the Gundam pilots encounter Milliardo and his Epyon.

videos.title: Battleship Libra
videos.overview: The survivors of the destruction of Barge are brought to Earth, one of them being Lady Une. Treize reveals his true intentions. As the battle continues, Relena heads for Libra.

videos.title: Target: Earth
videos.overview: The Gundam pilots reunite. OZ takes control of a colony demanding the White Fang surrender Libra. When Trowa learns that Catherine is in the colony, he leaps to action. Meanwhile, Relena struggles to talk some sense into her brother.

videos.title: Go Forth, Gundam Team
videos.overview: Relena's plead for her brother to stop the war goes unheeded. The Gundam pilots battle their way though a fierce encounter with Mobile Dolls under Dorothy's control.

videos.title: Signs of the Final Battle
videos.overview: Milliardo leaves Quinze in command temporarily as he takes a rest. The Mercurius and Vayeate are once again used against the Gundams. However, this proves to be the two Mobile Suits' last battle.

videos.title: Milliardo's Decision
videos.overview: Heero manages to get into the Libra and reunites with Relena to confront Milliardo. Treize challenges Milliardo with his new Tallgeese II Mobile Suit. To try and eliminate Treize, he fires the Libra...

videos.title: Collision in Space
videos.overview: The five Gundams launch their ultimate offensive knowing that only mass slaughter and a sad battlefield awaits them. The Peacemillion space fortress rams the Libra to block White Fang's way to Earth, even if it will bring their own death.

videos.title: Takeoff Into Confusion
videos.overview: While Wufei fights Treize, Quatre fights Dorothy, Trowa tries to change his destiny, Duo frees the scientists, and Heero looks for Milliardo for the last round of their duel.

videos.title: The Final Victor
videos.overview: As Heero and Zechs come to the end of their final duel, the battleship Libra and Peacemillion descend upon the earth threatening to engulf the world in a never ending winter.... Meanwhile Trowa helps out the wounded Quatre, and Duo delivers the "lords of plague" to peacemillion, in the hopes of averting the tradgedy of the battleships plunge.
